mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, CASE WHEN c.status = 1 AND c.withdrawn_at IS NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS ai_usage_consented FROM tbl_user u LEFT JOIN tbl_asset_snapshot s ON s.user_id = u.id AND s.`year_month` = #{yearMonth} LEFT JOIN tbl_user_consent c ON c.user_id = u.id AND c.consent_type = 'AI_USAGE' WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.created_at < #{targetMonthEnd} AND ( s.id IS NULL OR s.ai_analysis_status = 'NOT_REQUESTED' OR ( s.ai_analysis_status = 'FAILED' AND s.ai_analysis_attempt_count < #{maxAutoAttempts} AND s.ai_analysis_failed_at IS NOT NULL AND s.ai_analysis_failed_at <= #{retryNotBefore} AND s.ai_analysis_failure_code IN ('TOO_MANY_REQUESTS', 'AI_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE') ) ) ORDER BY u.id
